content.title: Jimmy Kimmel to return as host for 2023 Oscars - IMDb
content.text: Jimmy Kimmel to return as host for 2023 OscarsJimmy Kimmel will be returning to front the 95th Oscars in 2023, marking the talk show host’s third time presenting the ceremony.Kimmel first hosted the awards in 2017, the year that La La Land was mistakenly announced as the Best Picture winner over Moonlight, the true winner. The second time he hosted was in 2018.The Jimmy Kimmel Live host’s return was announced by Glenn Weiss and Ricky Kirshner, the executive producers and showrunners of the Academy Awards.“Being invited to host the Oscars for a third time is either a great honour or a trap,” Kimmel said in a statement. “Either way, I am grateful to the Academy for asking me so quickly after everyone good said no.”Last year, the event was hosted by trio Amy Schumer, Wanda Sykes and Regina Hall, with Apple TV movie Coda winning Best Picture.The Whale, The Banshees of Inisherin and Elvis...See full article at The Independent - Film11/7/2022by Ellie HarrisonThe Independent - FilmSimilar NewsJimmy KimmelNiall Horan Says There Are Plans to Bring His ‘Dinner Party’ Tour to the U.S.3/26/2026by Emily ZemlerRollingstone.comThe Drama Backlash: Why Zendaya and Robert Pattinson’s Next Movie is Becoming Controversial3/25/2026by Sonika KambleFandomWireZendaya & Robert Pattinson Movie 'The Drama' Faces Backlash Over Reported Controversial Twist3/25/2026by Just JaredJust JaredChris Rock (I)Chris Rock's Chilling, Overlooked 2021 Horror Movie Is Streaming On Netflix3/23/2026by Ryan ScottSlash FilmMatt Damon & Kevin Smith's 'Dogma' Is a Streaming Success on Apple Ahead of Sequel3/19/2026by Archie FennMovieWeb5 Celebrities Who Were Banned Or Expelled From The Academy Awards3/17/2026by Baila Eve ZismanUinterviewWill Smith (I)Michael B.
